notes: Quotes are short excerpts from pages opened with WebFetch. Google Trends and pageviews were not consulted. 'Vote' cases (Enchirito, Beefy Crunch) are anchored on the company post that opened the comeback vote, the first company signal that the item would return; the winner date is given as alt.

cases.announce_quote: The Chicken Fries are available at participating Burger King locations for a limited time only.
cases.outcome_quote: BK announced that the breaded and fried chicken strips were becoming a permanent part of the menu.
cases.outcome_note: The 2014 run was limited; Burger King returned them as a permanent national menu item in March 2015, inside the 24 months.
cases.confidence_reason: Permanent status sourced to March 2015; no source dated at Aug 2016 itself, but no cutback was found.

cases.announce_quote: they will bring SPICY CHICKEN NUGGETS BACK.
cases.outcome_quote: You can get a free Wendy's spicy chicken sandwich or 10-Piece spicy chicken nuggets w/any purchase today.
cases.outcome_note: Returned to all restaurants Aug 12, 2019 and was still sold nationally in April 2021 (a national app offer).
cases.confidence_reason: On May 4 Wendy's promised a return if a tweet hit 2M likes; it confirmed on May 6 (a Monday, the next week). The outcome rests on an April 2021 promotion, not a menu statement. The search term overlaps with McDonald's Spicy McNuggets from 2020, so the series may be noisy.

cases.announce_quote: After years of only being available in Canada, General Mills has announced the relaunch of Dunkaroos in the United States.
cases.outcome_quote: In May 2020, Dunkaroos began arriving at 7-Eleven stores in the United States.
cases.outcome_note: Rolled out to 7-Eleven then Walmart, Target and Kroger in 2020, with new varieties added in 2022 and an ongoing US market listing; only the spin-off cereal was discontinued.
cases.confidence_reason: ABC7 is dated 2020-02-04; a search snippet (iHeart, not opened) puts the company announcement on Monday 2020-02-03, the same week. General Mills also quietly opened Dunkaroos social accounts in January 2020, a possible earlier teaser that is not dated to the day.
